definition: A word for a man or boy after a verb or preposition.

spanish.definition: Palabra para un hombre o niño después de un verbo o preposición.

definition: A word for a woman or girl; belonging to her.

spanish.definition: Palabra para una mujer o niña; que le pertenece a ella.

definition: Belonging to a man or boy.

spanish.definition: Que le pertenece a un hombre o niño.

definition: Belonging to a thing or animal.
examples: The city is known for its food.

spanish.definition: Que le pertenece a una cosa o animal.

definition: A word for two or more people or things after a verb or preposition.

spanish.definition: Palabra para dos o más personas o cosas después de un verbo o preposición.

definition: A formal word for who after a verb or preposition.
examples: She is the woman whom I met.

spanish.definition: Palabra formal para quién después de un verbo o preposición.

definition: Any person who; it doesn't matter who.
examples: Whoever did this should say sorry.
Whoever comes first gets a seat.

spanish.definition: Cualquier persona que; no importa quién.

definition: The day after Sunday.

spanish.definition: El día después del domingo.

definition: The day after Monday.
examples: I go to the gym every Tuesday.

spanish.definition: El día después del lunes.

definition: The day after Wednesday.
examples: We have a meeting on Thursday.

spanish.definition: El día después del miércoles.

definition: The day after Thursday.
examples: Friday is the last work day.

spanish.definition: El día después del jueves.

definition: The day after Friday.

spanish.definition: El día después del viernes.

definition: The first month of the year.

spanish.definition: El primer mes del año.

definition: The second month of the year.
examples: It snowed a lot last February.

spanish.definition: El segundo mes del año.

definition: The third month of the year.

spanish.definition: El tercer mes del año.

definition: The fourth month of the year.
examples: It rains a lot in April.
The trip is in early April.

spanish.definition: El cuarto mes del año.

definition: The sixth month of the year.

spanish.definition: El sexto mes del año.

definition: The seventh month of the year.
examples: We go to the beach in July.

spanish.definition: El séptimo mes del año.

definition: The eighth month of the year.
examples: August is the end of summer.

spanish.definition: El octavo mes del año.

definition: The ninth month of the year.

spanish.definition: El noveno mes del año.

definition: The tenth month of the year.
examples: She started the job last October.

spanish.definition: El décimo mes del año.

definition: The eleventh month of the year.

spanish.definition: El undécimo mes del año.

definition: The last month of the year.

spanish.definition: El último mes del año.

definition: A round food from a chicken.
examples: I eat two eggs for breakfast.

spanish.definition: Alimento redondo que pone la gallina.

definition: A round red or green fruit.

spanish.definition: Fruta redonda roja o verde.

definition: A round sweet fruit; the color of that fruit.

spanish.definition: Fruta redonda y dulce; el color de esa fruta.

definition: A soft yellow food made from milk.
examples: I put butter on my toast.
The cake has a lot of butter.

spanish.definition: Alimento suave y amarillo hecho de leche.

definition: A white thing that gives food flavor.

spanish.definition: Algo blanco que da sabor a la comida.

definition: A food made from flour and baked.
examples: Do you want butter on your bread?

spanish.definition: Alimento hecho de harina y horneado.

definition: A food made from milk.

spanish.definition: Alimento hecho de leche.

definition: A sweet white food.
examples: Do you take sugar in your coffee?
This cake has too much sugar.

spanish.definition: Alimento dulce y blanco.

definition: A hot liquid food.
examples: I had chicken soup for lunch.

spanish.definition: Comida líquida y caliente.

definition: A sweet brown food made from cocoa.
examples: He gave me a box of chocolates.

spanish.definition: Alimento dulce y marrón hecho de cacao.

definition: A round food with cheese and tomato on bread.
examples: I had two slices of pizza.

spanish.definition: Comida redonda con queso y tomate sobre pan.

definition: A baked food with fruit or meat inside.
examples: Do you want a piece of pie?

spanish.definition: Comida horneada con fruta o carne dentro.

definition: A drink made from fruit.
examples: I drink orange juice every morning.
Do you have any apple juice?

spanish.definition: Bebida hecha de fruta.

definition: A small sweet baked food.

spanish.definition: Alimento pequeño, dulce y horneado.

definition: Sweet food made with sugar.
examples: He bought a bag of candy.

spanish.definition: Comida dulce hecha con azúcar.

definition: A vegetable that grows under the ground.

spanish.definition: Verdura que crece bajo la tierra.

definition: A thick liquid for cooking or for machines.
examples: Add a little oil to the pan.
The price of oil went up.

spanish.definition: Líquido espeso para cocinar o para máquinas.

definition: A pink farm animal with a flat nose.
examples: The pig is in the mud.
They keep pigs on the farm.

spanish.definition: Animal de granja rosado de nariz plana.

definition: A large farm animal that gives milk.

spanish.definition: Animal grande de granja que da leche.

definition: A very small animal with a long tail; a computer tool.
examples: There's a mouse in the kitchen!
Click the button with your mouse.

spanish.definition: Animal muy pequeño de cola larga; herramienta de computadora.

definition: A small animal with long ears.
examples: My son has a pet rabbit.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño de orejas largas.

definition: A large wild cat from Africa.
examples: We saw a lion at the zoo.
A lion is a strong animal.

spanish.definition: Felino grande y salvaje de África.

definition: A long animal with no legs.
examples: The snake moved under the rock.

spanish.definition: Animal largo sin patas.

definition: An animal that climbs trees and has a long tail.

spanish.definition: Animal que trepa árboles y tiene cola larga.

definition: An animal that lives with you at home.
examples: My pet is a small dog.

spanish.definition: Animal que vive contigo en casa.

definition: A thing that children play with.
examples: The baby has a new toy.

spanish.definition: Algo con lo que juegan los niños.

definition: The part of your head that you hear with.

spanish.definition: La parte de la cabeza con la que oyes.

definition: One of the two edges of your mouth.

spanish.definition: Uno de los dos bordes de la boca.

definition: The part of your body between your neck and arm.
examples: She put her head on my shoulder.

spanish.definition: La parte del cuerpo entre el cuello y el brazo.

definition: One of the five long parts of your hand.
examples: She wears a ring on her finger.
Don't point your finger at me.

spanish.definition: Una de las cinco partes largas de la mano.

definition: One of the five small parts of your foot.

spanish.definition: Una de las cinco partes pequeñas del pie.

definition: The part of your body where food goes.
examples: Don't swim on a full stomach.

spanish.definition: La parte del cuerpo adonde va la comida.

definition: The front part of your body above the stomach; a big box.
examples: I have a pain in my chest.
He crossed his arms over his chest.
The old chest was full of gold.

spanish.definition: La parte frontal del cuerpo sobre el estómago; caja grande.

definition: The soft part inside your mouth.
examples: The doctor looked at my tongue.
The dog stuck out its tongue.

spanish.definition: La parte blanda dentro de la boca.

definition: How heavy something or someone is.
examples: What's the weight of this box?
He lifts weights at the gym.

spanish.definition: Cuánto pesa algo o alguien.

definition: A man who rules a country.
examples: The king lives in a castle.
He was king for thirty years.
She met the king of Spain.

spanish.definition: Hombre que gobierna un país.

definition: How hot, cold, wet, or dry it is outside.
examples: We stayed home because of the bad weather.

spanish.definition: Qué tan caliente, frío, húmedo o seco está afuera.

definition: A place where you grow plants and flowers.
examples: There are roses in the garden.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde cultivas plantas y flores.

definition: Something you take when you are sick.

spanish.definition: Algo que tomas cuando estás enfermo.

definition: Soft white ice that falls from the sky.
examples: The kids are playing in the snow.
We got a lot of snow last night.

spanish.definition: Hielo blanco y suave que cae del cielo.

definition: The coldest season of the year.

spanish.definition: La estación más fría del año.

definition: The season after winter.

spanish.definition: La estación después del invierno.

definition: A large area of water with land around it.
examples: Our cabin is near a lake.

spanish.definition: Gran área de agua rodeada de tierra.

definition: A large area with many trees.
examples: We got lost in the forest.
The forest is quiet at night.

spanish.definition: Gran área con muchos árboles.

definition: High land that is smaller than a mountain.
examples: The house is on a hill.

spanish.definition: Tierra alta más pequeña que una montaña.

definition: Land where people grow food and keep animals.
examples: My uncle lives on a farm.

spanish.definition: Tierra donde se cultiva comida y se crían animales.

definition: A very large area of salt water.
examples: I love swimming in the ocean.
The hotel looks over the ocean.
The ocean is very cold here.

spanish.definition: Área muy grande de agua salada.

definition: Glass that shows your image.
examples: There's a mirror in the bathroom.

spanish.definition: Vidrio que muestra tu imagen.

definition: A small bag in your clothes.
examples: My keys are in my pocket.
He put his hands in his pockets.

spanish.definition: Pequeña bolsa en tu ropa.

definition: Warm clothes you wear outside.
examples: It's cold, so wear a coat.
I hung my coat by the door.

spanish.definition: Ropa cálida que usas afuera.

definition: A short coat.
examples: He left his jacket in the car.

spanish.definition: Abrigo corto.

definition: Clothes that cover each leg.
examples: He spilled coffee on his pants.

spanish.definition: Ropa que cubre cada pierna.

definition: A thing that shows the time.
examples: The clock on the wall is wrong.
She set her alarm clock for six.

spanish.definition: Algo que muestra la hora.

definition: A room where you sleep.

spanish.definition: Habitación donde duermes.

definition: A bathroom seat for getting rid of body waste.

spanish.definition: Asiento del baño para los desechos del cuerpo.

definition: A place where planes land and take off.
examples: I'll pick you up at the airport.
The airport is far from here.
We got to the airport early.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde aterrizan y despegan los aviones.

definition: A car you pay to ride in.

spanish.definition: Carro que pagas para que te lleve.

definition: A vehicle with two wheels that you pedal.
examples: I ride my bike to work.

spanish.definition: Vehículo de dos ruedas que pedaleas.

definition: A big instrument with black and white keys.

spanish.definition: Instrumento grande con teclas blancas y negras.

definition: A device for talking to people far away.

spanish.definition: Aparato para hablar con gente lejana.

definition: A device with a screen for watching shows.

spanish.definition: Aparato con pantalla para ver programas.

definition: Time away from work or school.
examples: We're going on vacation next week.

spanish.definition: Tiempo fuera del trabajo o la escuela.

definition: A school for adults after high school.
examples: She goes to a good university.

spanish.definition: Escuela para adultos después de la secundaria.

definition: An American game played with an oval ball.

spanish.definition: Juego estadounidense con un balón ovalado.

definition: The top of a building.
examples: A bird is on the roof.
We fixed the roof last year.

spanish.definition: La parte de arriba de un edificio.

definition: A door in a fence or wall; a place to board a plane.

spanish.definition: Puerta en una cerca o muro; lugar para abordar un avión.

definition: A large old building with thick walls.
examples: The king lives in a castle.
The kids built a sand castle.

spanish.definition: Edificio grande y antiguo con muros gruesos.

definition: A drawing of places and roads.
examples: I found the street on my phone's map.
Do you have a map of the city?

spanish.definition: Dibujo de lugares y caminos.

definition: A place where you can borrow books.
examples: She works at the public library.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde puedes pedir libros prestados.

definition: A building with art or old things to see.
examples: The museum is closed on Mondays.

spanish.definition: Edificio con arte u objetos antiguos para ver.

definition: A thing that keeps the rain off you.
examples: I left my umbrella on the bus.
It's raining and I have no umbrella.

spanish.definition: Objeto que te protege de la lluvia.

definition: A small case for money and cards.
examples: He took a bill out of his wallet.
Is your wallet in your pocket?

spanish.definition: Estuche pequeño para dinero y tarjetas.

definition: Cloth worn around the neck; to make a knot.
examples: She tied the rope to the tree.

spanish.definition: Tela que se usa en el cuello; hacer un nudo.

definition: A soft thing for your head in bed.
examples: She fell asleep on my pillow.

spanish.definition: Algo suave para la cabeza en la cama.

definition: A warm cover for your bed.
examples: She put a blanket on the baby.

spanish.definition: Cubierta caliente para la cama.

definition: The father of your mother or father.
examples: My grandfather taught me to fish.

spanish.definition: El padre de tu madre o tu padre.

definition: The mother of your mother or father.

spanish.definition: La madre de tu madre o tu padre.

definition: Your grandfather.

spanish.definition: Tu abuelo.
